'''Hyperdrive''' was an [[Electric organ]] [[Band/Legends|band]] that consisted of four performers, who were led by the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Moritz Nor]]. On one evening in around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Jigsaw: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian|Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> they performed in the [[Starlight Lounge]] in [[Tolea Biqua]] on [[Genarius]].
